# ssync_asset (Resource)

The asset records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `mime_type` (String) type/subtype
- `name` (String)
- `path` (String) A relative path that does not escape its prefix
- `sa_owner_id` (String)

### Optional

- `context` (String) What the asset is used as, such as icon or export
- `description` (String)
- `size_bytes` (Number)
- `type` (String)
- `visibility` (Dynamic)
